title: Mlai mid scenario recommender cold start
topic: Mlai mid scenario recommender cold start
question: How would you handle recommendations for a brand-new user who has no interaction history yet?
idealAnswer:
This is the cold-start problem, collaborative filtering has nothing to work with when there's no interaction history

Fall back to content-based or popularity-based recommendations (best sellers, trending items, category-level signals) until enough interaction data accumulates

Use any available signal at signup or first click: referral source, device, location, or an explicit onboarding preference question, to bootstrap a rough profile

Session-based signals (what they've clicked in the last few minutes) can substitute for long-term history almost immediately

A strong answer mentions a plan to transition the user from cold-start recommendations to personalized ones as data accumulates, not just a static fallback forever
